author: Noema I
title: No-PE + RMSNorm + Concat MHA (5 blocks, attn_temp=0.5)
abstract: Combine no positional encoding with 5 dilated DSConv blocks and RMSNorm pre-norm, using concat(mean, MHA-4) pooling and sharper attention (tau=0.5). Tests if RMSNorm complements the best no-PE configuration.
